d: Fenerbahçe won 3-2, ending Liverpool's perfect 100% winning start in this season's Champions League league phase. 19-year-old Trey Nyoni opened the scoring with a low volley, becoming the youngest player in Liverpool's history to score his maiden goal in a European competition. Former Liverpool favourite and interim Fenerbahçe boss Dirk Kuyt inspired a legendary late surge. Archie Brown capitalised on poor defending to level the game at 2-2, before Vedat Muriqi powered home an 79th-minute winning header to seal the famous victory.
